lines.zh: 我走得比 X 快半拍。
lines.en: I walk half a beat faster than X.

lines.zh: 月尘太细，踩下去陷半脚。
lines.en: Moon dust is fine; each step sinks half a foot.

lines.zh: 我沿着铁围栏转，找缺口。
lines.en: I circle the iron fence, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 没有脚印留下，这里太干。
lines.en: No footprints remain; it is too dry.

lines.zh: 我把破布系紧，免得绊脚。
lines.en: I tie my rags tight so they stop snagging.

lines.zh: 环形山的坡，我一步跨过去。
lines.en: I cross the crater slope in a single step.

lines.zh: 这条路通向哪儿？我记得是墙。
lines.en: Where does this lead? I recall a wall.

lines.zh: 我的影子在灰上拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long across the grey.
I do not detour; I cut straight across.

lines.zh: 脚底的铁板响，我踩轻些。
lines.en: The iron plate rings; I step lighter.

lines.zh: 月球的重力让我差点飘起来。
lines.en: The moon's pull nearly lifts me off.
I can cross this waste in a day.

lines.zh: 我站在坑边，看自己的影子。
lines.en: I stand at the crater edge and watch my shadow.
Not even an insect lives here.
I rub my knuckles, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 一百四十五点，够我撑很久。
lines.en: One hundred forty-five; enough to last long.
No wind comes, and the dust stays still.
I bend an iron strip, then straighten it.
That blue one up there, is it home?
I do not sit; sitting makes rising harder.

lines.zh: 这一片灰，我闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I could walk this grey with my eyes shut.
It is quiet enough to make me want to smash things.

lines.zh: 你比 X 说的要高一点。
lines.en: You are a little taller than X described.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，眼睛不眨一下。
lines.en: My eyes do not blink once while I watch you.

lines.zh: 你走过来，月尘都热了一点。
lines.en: You approach and the moon dust warms slightly.

lines.zh: 这地方来客很少，我记住你了。
lines.en: Few visitors come here; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 你带的东西，在月面留不住。
lines.en: Whatever you brought will not last here.

lines.zh: 别背对我，我不喜欢这样。
lines.en: Do not turn your back; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你看的方向，全是我走过的路。
lines.en: Every way you look, I have already walked.

lines.zh: 我挡在路中间，你过不去。
lines.en: I stand in the path; you cannot pass.
Moon dust clings to your boot soles.
I have waited a long time for this day.
That blow cut three steps short.
I guard my ribs and back off.
You hit hard; I grant you that.
I take the blow without a sound.
One hundred forty-five; still enough to fight.

lines.zh: 血滴在月尘上，很快没了。
lines.en: Blood drips on moon dust and vanishes.
My rags took part of it.
That blow landed on an old scar.

lines.zh: 我咬破嘴唇，才没喊出来。
lines.en: I bit my lip to keep from shouting.

lines.zh: 你打的地方，我回头还你。
lines.en: Where you hit me, I will return it.
No food here, only iron.

lines.zh: 你晃晃手中的东西，我不动。
lines.en: You wave that thing; I do not move.
Eating would leave me empty; I do not eat.

lines.zh: 我的牙缺了两颗，咬不动。
lines.en: I am missing two teeth; I cannot bite.

lines.zh: 月面上长不出你要喂的东西。
lines.en: Nothing you could feed me grows on the moon.
That smell is too far to reach me.
Do not try to buy me with that.
I am hungry, but I do not chase food.

lines.zh: 举高些也没用，我不抬头。
lines.en: Raise it higher; I will not look up.
Save your food for someone else.
One hit from you and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我肩膀硬，撞上来不好受。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard; hitting it hurts.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，铁栏在晃。
lines.en: We collide and the iron bars sway.
Do not shove me; a deep crater is behind.
I force a path open; step aside.

lines.zh: 月尘扬起来，遮住我们两个。
lines.en: Moon dust rises and hides us both.
With that frame, you cannot knock me over.

lines.zh: 碰一下，我的破布又掉了。
lines.en: One bump and another scrap of rag falls.
I only stop once my back hits the bars.
After that bump, do not be quick to leave.

lines.zh: 编号 Y，没有别的一半。
lines.en: Designation Y; there is no other half.

lines.zh: 牢里配对，只是并排关着。
lines.en: Pairing in a cell is just being locked side by side.

lines.zh: 我和 X 隔着三根铁栏。
lines.en: X and I are three iron bars apart.
No next generation will come from this moon.
In these rags, there is no courting.
I do not even have an echo.

lines.zh: 看守换了三批，我还在这。
lines.en: Three shifts of guards have passed; I remain.
Do not ask; asking changes nothing.
My name has been struck out.

lines.zh: 这里只有编号，没有亲人。
lines.en: Only numbers here, no kin.

lines.zh: 这截铁条，正好塞进栏缝。
lines.en: This iron strip fits the bar gap nicely.
This strip of cloth wraps my hand well.
I pick it up and toss it; useless.
With something in hand, I hit harder.
Whose shard is this? I keep it.
Bending takes half a minute; worth it?

lines.zh: 月锭我不稀罕，铁更实在。
lines.en: I do not care for lunide; iron is honest.
I tuck it into a fold of cloth.

lines.zh: 捡完我拍手，灰落了一地。
lines.en: I clap my hands and dust falls.
I cannot carry this; too heavy.
You have walked into my passage.

lines.zh: 我听见铁板在你脚下响。
lines.en: I hear the iron plate ring under you.
One target only, you; very good.

lines.zh: 我十五点力气，一次就够。
lines.en: Fifteen points behind one punch is plenty.
Do not run that way; it is a dead end.
I come slowly; you will not escape.
The moon is so open; no one can hide.
I have locked on; do not look back.

lines.zh: 月尘太薄，你的脚步藏不住。
lines.en: The moon dust is thin. Your steps give you away.
I am holding this path today.
The lamp in your hand flickered once.

lines.zh: 我不出声，月面替我把声音吞了。
lines.en: I stay silent; the moon swallows the sound.
You are at the bars; no way left.
This place is finally not empty.

lines.zh: 你踩响了那盏坏掉的灯。
lines.en: You stepped on that broken lamp

lines.zh: 我的编号是 Y，你的呢。
lines.en: My number is Y; what is yours

lines.zh: 我数着铁板，一格一格靠近。
lines.en: I count the plates, closing one square at a time.
You retreat; I fill the gap.
My fist tightens at my side.
Thirty paces, twenty, ten.
You raise the shield; I strike your legs.

lines.zh: 我不看你的眼睛，看你的脚。
lines.en: I keep my gaze on your boots, not your face.
Moon dust kicks up behind my feet.
This passage is too narrow to dodge in.

lines.zh: 我肩膀往前，脚还在原位。
lines.en: My shoulder leads, but my feet stay put.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反着光，很显眼。
lines.en: Your armor throws light; easy to track.

lines.zh: 再等一下，等你自己靠近。
lines.en: Just a moment more; let you come closer.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，越来越快。
lines.en: I count your breaths, quickening.

lines.zh: 铁栏把我们的影子叠在一起。
lines.en: The bars overlay our two shadows.
We are almost there.

lines.zh: 月球上没有影子，你也藏不住。
lines.en: There are no shadows on the moon; you cannot hide.
I drop my weight and wait for you to move first

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越急，我听着。
lines.en: Your breathing quickens; I hear it

lines.zh: 铁栏的影子在我们中间。
lines.en: The bars' shadow lies between us

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，月球的尘土在脚下。
lines.en: I press on step by step, moon dust under my feet.
There is a wall behind you now
My fist lands on your ribs.

lines.zh: 十五点，比 X 多一点。
lines.en: Fifteen, a little more than X deals.
You stagger four steps and grab a bar.
I miss and dent the iron plate.
You block it and your arm shakes.
I held nothing back in that punch.

lines.zh: 月面滑，我打完差点摔倒。
lines.en: The moon is slick; I nearly fell after.
Your lip has gone red.
One more punch; do not move.
The impact makes a crisp sound.
I shake my hand; a knuckle has split.
You give ground and I take the space.
That one will give you a moment's rest.
I do not stop; here comes another.

lines.zh: 我的手肘扫过你的下巴。
lines.en: My elbow sweeps across your jaw

lines.zh: 你被砸在铁栏上，栏在响。
lines.en: You hit the bars and they ring
I grab you and haul you back

lines.zh: 这一拳落在你的护肩上。
lines.en: This fist lands on your shoulder guard

lines.zh: 你没站稳，我又补了一下。
lines.en: You lose your footing, and I follow up
I pin you down in the moon dust
I walk out from behind the iron bars.
The moon gains one more inmate.
Weight one point two; I am uncommon.
Grey when I open my eyes, grey when I close them.
My number still hangs at my chest.
The smell of rust arrives before I do.
This waste; I am back again.
The iron plate rings underfoot; I have arrived.
The moon lights me with cold light.
I stand straighter, heavier than yesterday.
No windows here, and no doors.
My shadow lands first.
Fire does not burn well here.

lines.zh: 从坑沿翻下去，滚了很远。
lines.en: I tumble off the rim and roll far.

lines.zh: 月面没水，我却喝了一口。
lines.en: There is no water on the moon, yet I swallowed some.

lines.zh: 炸得我撞穿了两根栏杆。
lines.en: The blast throws me through two bars.
An arrow juts from my shoulder like a bone splinter.

lines.zh: 这股魔法在我胸口里乱窜。
lines.en: This magic darts around inside my chest.

lines.zh: 不吃也罢，反正不掉东西。
lines.en: Let me not eat; nothing drops anyway.

lines.zh: 雷打在月面上，没有回声。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the moon without an echo.
There are no numbers in the void.
